axes.model_access: The platform reaches each LLM via "model provider" plugins (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/local Ollama etc., installed uniformly through the Marketplace); officially models can be switched freely. The full provider list has not been verified item by item.
axes.runtime: Community edition source is open with Docker self-hosting (official homepage framing: one-command deployment, full agent runtime and Workflow editor); there is also a Dify official cloud service. Self-hosted data stays in your own environment.
axes.local_files: The knowledge-base line is officially described as "data pipelines for files, websites, online docs and cloud drives" (extraction/cleaning/chunking/indexing/retrieval testing); when self-hosted, files and indexes live on your own instance.
axes.background: Apps published as hosted apps/APIs/embeddable widgets/MCP-compatible tools are carried by the platform runtime; a self-hosted instance running continuously can serve persistently. Scheduled/background task forms not verified item by item.
axes.tools: Marketplace installs model providers, tools, data sources and MCP integrations (official homepage framing); apps can be published as MCP-compatible tools — it both consumes and produces MCP.
axes.context: The official Agent description includes "remembering context"; knowledge-base retrieval is the flagship official context-supply line. The concrete cross-session memory mechanism has not been verified item by item.
axes.permissions: The enterprise line officially lists SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logs, SOC 2 Type II + ISO 27001 (homepage framing); the community edition's permission model has not been verified item by item. License boundary (multi-tenant restriction) see the license field.
axes.fit: Fits: teams that want "prompt logic turned into a visible execution path", self-hosted Chinese-origin global-facing stacks, knowledge-base + agent delivered together. Does not fit: running multi-tenant SaaS from the source (needs commercial licensing); pure-code frameworks (belongs to framework).

sections.许可的两条附加条件: Key points of the official LICENSE text (paraphrased): **without written permission from Dify, you may not operate a multi-tenant environment from the source code** (one workspace = one tenant); **when using its frontend you may not remove or modify the console/app LOGO and copyright information** (frontend-free use is exempt). Everything else follows Apache 2.0. The interaction design is additionally covered by a design patent.

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the tool-calling and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no workflow-platform-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
